recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future DeviceAssociation changes should continue to avoid adding StructureDefinition/Person as a subject or focus target unless a later explicit work-group decision reverses the Person-participant rule.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive R5 change request to remove Person from Device.subject and clarify that people using devices outside a healthcare setting, such as fitness tracker users, are still represented as Patient rather than FHIR Person.
initial_application: Jira cites commit 5dfb107768496eb70edb269449cf60cef14a5088, which removed the Person target from Device.subject and added a Patient/fitness-tracker explanatory sentence to the Device.subject definition.
additional_context: FHIR-30243 originally broadened Device.patient to Device.subject and included Person; FHIR-34135 corrected that choice. FHIR-32570 later superseded Device.subject with association subject work, and FHIR-38904/FHIR-39009 resolved the overlapping Device subject changes by removing association data from Device and creating DeviceAssociation. The current build has active Device and DeviceAssociation resources; Device has no active Device.subject, and DeviceAssociation.subject does not target Person.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The active replacement surface, DeviceAssociation.subject, includes Patient, Practitioner, PractitionerRole, RelatedPerson, and other non-Person targets, while the DeviceAssociation narrative covers personal health devices and activity trackers under Patient.
